cmd: set -eu; mkdir -p /workspace; f=/workspace/runpod-template-bootstrap.sh; if curl -fLsS --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 90 --retry 3 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/martynguyen420-debug/MUNGBEAN/main/runpod-startup/github-bootstrap.sh -o "$f.new" && bash -n "$f.new"; then mv "$f.new" "$f"; else echo "GitHub unavailable: trying cached bootstrap"; fi; test -s "$f"; exec bash "$f"
